text:
Maya Rodriguez: Heads up — seeing a brief spike (~12:05 UTC) in TLS handshake retries for cross-region traffic hitting the external LB. ~3% of requests returned 502/504s for ~7m. Logs show repeated 'tls: handshake error: EOF'. Opening this thread to track follow-ups.
Jordan (oncall): I see it too. Correlating traces now. Putting a ticket together: INF-2026. Early signal looks like asymmetric routing to an older gateway in eu-west that has a cert mismatch.
Sam Patel: @Jordan can you paste the trace ids? I want to verify if it's only cross-region egress or also same-region.
Jordan (oncall): trace ids: 8f3a2b, 8f3a5d, 8f3b10 — all show client->edge->lb->backend hops where backend connection resets during TLS handshake.
Liam Chen: From LB metrics: sudden bump in upstream_conn_reset and tls_handshake_fail_rate between 12:04-12:11. Dumped a snippet from the proxy logs: ```
[2026-03-22T12:05:03Z] proxy: connection from 10.2.5.7:52344 -> backend-23 (eu-west) error tls: handshake error: EOF
[2026-03-22T12:05:04Z] proxy: upstream reset after TLS handshake failed
[2026-03-22T12:05:05Z] proxy: routing fallback to gateway-legacy-eu-west
```
Maya Rodriguez: That fallback to gateway-legacy-eu-west is the pattern I feared. We rolled that gateway in last month for cache warmup but didn't pin cert rotations.
Sam Patel: Reproduced locally by forcing route to legacy gateway; cert chain shows a missing intermediate on that gateway. Looks like cert refresh script failed on gateway-legacy.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: proxy-config rollout -> reverting route-policy change that caused fallback. CI/CD job #4482 triggered.
Jordan (oncall): Rollback reduced error rate, 502s dropped back to baseline by 12:12. Good containment.
Maya Rodriguez: Action items: 1) Fix cert refresh on gateway-legacy and validate rotation automation (owner: Sam Patel, due: 2026-04-02). 2) Add guard in smart-routing to avoid falling back to legacy gateways with cert age > 7d (owner: Liam Chen, due: 2026-03-29). 3) Postmortem writeup and recurrence analysis (owner: Maya Rodriguez, due: 2026-03-30). 4) Add synthetic cross-region TLS test to health checks (owner: Eng QA, triage-bot to create ticket INF-2027).
Sam Patel: Confirming I will own cert refresh. Plan: audit all legacy gateways, run manual refresh, then fix the automation script. I'll post a runbook snippet.
Liam Chen: For the guard I propose adding a simple pre-check in routing: if gateway.cert_expires_in < 7d then exclude from fallback. Will open PR and link here.
triage-bot: Created INF-2027: cross-region-tls-synth-check. Assigned to Eng QA.
Maya Rodriguez: Notes for follow-ups: check historical incidents for pattern of fallback->old-gateway over past 90d. If recurring, plan decommission of legacy gateways on a schedule. Also add alert: tls_handshake_fail_rate >= 1% sustained for 5m -> paging.
Jordan (oncall): Putting incident notes in the incident tracker and marking as mitigated. Will attach graphs and the proxy log snips.
Sam Patel: Quick checklist I'm following: - run certtool --check gateway-legacy-eu-west -> fails on intermediate - run certtool --force-refresh -> success - validate handshake with openssl s_client -CAfile chain.pem -> OK. Will post commands and timestamps after I finish.
Liam Chen: I'll draft the PR for routing guard by EOD and request review from Maya and Sam.
Maya Rodriguez: Thanks everyone. Reassigning owners in INF-2026: Sam (certs), Liam (routing guard), Maya (postmortem). I'll follow up in this thread with the postmortem link and final RCA. :white_check_mark:
Sam Patel: ping — PRs and runbook links incoming. :hammer_and_wrench:
Jordan (oncall): Closing incident timeline here, moving to follow-up channel after postmortem. :eyes:
